daily_experiment_boundary: No row download or statistical evaluation on 2026-10-28; today's completed screen consumed the daily experiment slot.
hypothesis: The predeclared fade/rest comparator from inspected 2024-25 evidence also covers above the hypothetical -110 break-even frequency in 2025-26 under unchanged rest/handicap rules.
source_review: Publisher README metadata and league-wide aggregate summaries already visible. Individual rows and B2B subgroup outcomes not inspected. Same compiler is not independent-source validation; do not call this a wholly blind external holdout. Publisher CC BY4.0 label does not certify all upstream rights.
development_evidence: nba-b2b-closing-screen-v1: 2024-25 inspected; 106W79L fade comparator is motivation, not part of replication sample or probability training.

population.reason: Known Cup knockout omission; retain exclusion before outcomes. Exclude unavailable prior game, non-half-point spread, invalid schedule coverage or unmet rest population. No postseason.

selection: Exactly one B2B team: consecutive America/New_York dates AND 18<=tip-to-tip elapsed hours<=36; opponent elapsed>=48h from its previous exact source-ID game. Take the opponent's exact opposite signed half-point consensus closing spread regardless favorite status. One observation per game; no underdog/home/travel/price/workload subgroups.
coverage_gate: Fingerprint source bytes and audit exact team IDs, unique game IDs, ET/UTC identity, season dates, final scores/OT and ATS label/margin reconciliation before computing selection results. Audit known missing fixtures against retained rest sequences. Stop on unresolved affected-game schedule gaps; never invent prior games, silently repair data, change exclusion months or count unverified rows as complete. Calendar dates must lie within July2025-June2026.

sample_gate.if_insufficient: Report all fixed counts as descriptive inconclusive; no rescue variants or changed floor.

primary_endpoint: Fade-side wins/(wins+losses). Half-point spreads imply no pushes; unexpected push fails audit. Compare against exact hypothetical break-even 110/210; do not substitute a game-level model probability.

uncertainty.primary_descriptive_interval: Circular moving-block bootstrap over Monday-start ET calendar-week aggregates, including zero-eligible weeks between first/last eligible dates. Draw uniform block starts, concatenate consecutive 4-week blocks with wraparound until original number of weeks, truncate. Each replicate is summed wins/summed decisions; skip zero-decision replicates and record skips. 20,000 valid replicates; cap100,000 attempts; seed20261029; stdlib random.Random. Sort replicates and use nearest-rank 2.5%/97.5% quantiles (ceil(q*N)-1). Record original nonempty weeks/total weeks and block length.
uncertainty.limits: Captures local week dependence approximately, not full season-long team dependence or independent-source uncertainty. No confirmatory p-value, familywise certification or production validation.

accounting: Fixed one-unit risk, blanket -110 returns as counterfactual sensitivity only; wins*(100/110)-losses. No actual offered-book prices/times, executable ROI, fees/CLV/fills or stake advice.
report: Preserve record, source SHA256, every exclusion, unique games/weeks, both intervals, hypothetical unit arithmetic, all audit failures. Single primary rule only. Disappointing/inconclusive results retained; no cutoff search or pooled post-selection rescue.
interpretation: A lower bootstrap interval above 110/210 is a replication lead only; otherwise not supported/inconclusive. Either outcome requires prospective source-complete paper evidence and actual eligible-book prices before any future card. No automatic promotion.
implementation_gate: The 2024-25 helper intentionally rejects this season. Write separately protocol-bound evaluator plus synthetic tests and verify no changed original results BEFORE row-level evaluation. Registration is not implementation completion.
